```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

options(scipen = 999)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PURPOSE
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare a SINGLE Mplus data file for the parent-only dyadic piecewise
# latent growth curve model.
#
# Inclusion criteria (from manuscript Methods):
#   - Parent couples only (group = 1)
#   - Both partners must have observed life satisfaction at:
#       signal 0 (three years before childbirth)
#       signal 2 (one year before childbirth)
#       signal 3 (childbirth reporting year)
#   - Both partners must have at least 6 of 8 observed LS values
#
# These criteria yielded N = 679 parent couples in the original analysis.
#
# Unlike the multi-group model, this model:
#   - Uses no entropy-balancing weights
#   - Uses no multiple imputation (MI was for covariate imputation
#     used in entropy balancing, which is not relevant here)
#   - Exports a single data file (not TYPE = IMPUTATION)
#
# Missing LS values at non-required signals are retained and handled
# by Mplus under MLR/FIML.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

PARENT_PATH <- here(
  "data",
  "derived",
  "parent.rds"
)

MPLUS_ROOT <- here(
  "data",
  "mplus",
  "parent_only"
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(PARENT_PATH)
)

dir.create(
  MPLUS_ROOT,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

parent_long <- readRDS(
  PARENT_PATH
)
```

## 1. Verify the raw parent outcome grid

```{r}
parent_long <- parent_long %>%
  transmute(
    couple_id = as.character(couple_id),
    pid = as.numeric(pid),
    sex = as.numeric(sex),
    signal = as.integer(signal),
    life_sat = as.numeric(life_sat)
  )

stopifnot(
  all(parent_long$sex %in% c(1, 2)),
  all(parent_long$signal %in% 0:7)
)

# Every person should have exactly 8 signal positions
person_grid <- parent_long %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    sex
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_signals = n_distinct(signal),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  all(person_grid$n_rows == 8L),
  all(person_grid$n_signals == 8L)
)

# One male and one female per couple
couple_check <- parent_long %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    sex
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_male = sum(sex == 1),
    n_female = sum(sex == 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  all(couple_check$n_male == 1L),
  all(couple_check$n_female == 1L)
)

n_parent_total <- n_distinct(parent_long$couple_id)

cat(
  "Total parent couples in raw data:",
  n_parent_total,
  "\n"
)
```

## 2. Apply parent-only inclusion criteria

Both partners must have:
- Observed LS at signal 0 (three years before childbirth)
- Observed LS at signal 2 (one year before childbirth)
- Observed LS at signal 3 (childbirth reporting year)
- At least 6 of 8 observed LS values

```{r}
person_eligibility <- parent_long %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    sex
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observed = sum(!is.na(life_sat)),
    has_signal0 = !is.na(life_sat[signal == 0L]),
    has_signal2 = !is.na(life_sat[signal == 2L]),
    has_signal3 = !is.na(life_sat[signal == 3L]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    meets_criteria =
      n_observed >= 6L &
      has_signal0 &
      has_signal2 &
      has_signal3
  )

# Both partners must meet criteria
couple_eligibility <- person_eligibility %>%
  group_by(
    couple_id
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    both_eligible = all(meets_criteria),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

eligible_couples <- couple_eligibility %>%
  filter(
    both_eligible
  ) %>%
  pull(
    couple_id
  )

n_eligible <- length(eligible_couples)

cat(
  "Couples meeting parent-only criteria:",
  n_eligible,
  "\n"
)

# Report exclusions
cat(
  "Couples excluded:",
  n_parent_total - n_eligible,
  "\n"
)

# Diagnostic: reasons for exclusion
excluded_persons <- person_eligibility %>%
  filter(
    !meets_criteria
  )

if (nrow(excluded_persons) > 0) {
  cat(
    "\nExclusion reasons among ineligible persons:\n"
  )

  cat(
    "  Missing signal 0:",
    sum(!excluded_persons$has_signal0),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "  Missing signal 2:",
    sum(!excluded_persons$has_signal2),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "  Missing signal 3:",
    sum(!excluded_persons$has_signal3),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "  Fewer than 6 observed:",
    sum(excluded_persons$n_observed < 6L),
    "\n"
  )
}

# Verify expected N
if (n_eligible != 679L) {
  warning(
    "Expected 679 parent couples but found ",
    n_eligible,
    ". Check upstream pipeline if this is unexpected."
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "\nPASS: N = 679 parent couples, as expected.\n"
  )
}
```

## 3. Filter and pivot to wide format

```{r}
parent_eligible <- parent_long %>%
  filter(
    couple_id %in% eligible_couples
  )

male_wide <- parent_eligible %>%
  filter(
    sex == 1
  ) %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    signal,
    life_sat
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ls_name = paste0(
      "M_LS",
      signal
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -signal
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      couple_id,
      pid
    ),
    names_from = ls_name,
    values_from = life_sat
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PID_M = pid
  )

female_wide <- parent_eligible %>%
  filter(
    sex == 2
  ) %>%
  select(
    couple_id,
    pid,
    signal,
    life_sat
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ls_name = paste0(
      "F_LS",
      signal
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -signal
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      couple_id,
      pid
    ),
    names_from = ls_name,
    values_from = life_sat
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PID_F = pid
  )

outcome_wide <- male_wide %>%
  inner_join(
    female_wide,
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    couple_id
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(outcome_wide) == n_eligible,
  n_distinct(outcome_wide$couple_id) == n_eligible
)

# Create stable numeric ID
couple_key <- outcome_wide %>%
  distinct(
    couple_id
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    couple_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    couple_id_num = row_number()
  )

outcome_wide <- outcome_wide %>%
  left_join(
    couple_key,
    by = "couple_id"
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    couple_id_num,
    .before = couple_id
  )

cat(
  "Created wide-format dataset with",
  nrow(outcome_wide),
  "parent couples.\n"
)
```

## 4. Export Mplus data file

Column order: `couple_id_num PID_M M_LS0..M_LS7 PID_F F_LS0..F_LS7`

No PARENT grouping variable (single group).
No WEIGHT variable (no entropy balancing).

```{r}
mplus_columns <- c(
  "couple_id_num",
  "PID_M",
  paste0(
    "M_LS",
    0:7
  ),
  "PID_F",
  paste0(
    "F_LS",
    0:7
  )
)

mplus_out <- outcome_wide %>%
  select(
    all_of(
      mplus_columns
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(mplus_out),
    mplus_columns
  )
)

file_path <- file.path(
  MPLUS_ROOT,
  "parent_only.dat"
)

write.table(
  mplus_out,
  file = file_path,
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE,
  sep = " ",
  na = "999"
)

# Column dictionary
writeLines(
  c(
    "Mplus column order:",
    paste(
      mplus_columns,
      collapse = " "
    ),
    "",
    "Missing value code: 999",
    "Single-group parent-only model (no PARENT or WEIGHT columns)",
    paste0(
      "Expected couples: ",
      n_eligible
    )
  ),
  con = file.path(
    MPLUS_ROOT,
    "parent_only_columns.txt"
  )
)

# Save couple key for cross-referencing
write_csv(
  couple_key,
  file.path(
    MPLUS_ROOT,
    "parent_only_couple_key.csv"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nExported Mplus data file:\n  ",
  file_path,
  "\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## 5. Missingness summary

```{r}
missing_by_signal <- parent_eligible %>%
  group_by(
    sex,
    signal
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_observed = sum(!is.na(life_sat)),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(life_sat)),
    pct_missing = round(
      100 * mean(is.na(life_sat)),
      1
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sex_label = if_else(
      sex == 2,
      "Female",
      "Male"
    )
  )

print(
  missing_by_signal,
  n = Inf
)

cat(
  "\nSignals 0, 2, and 3 should have 0% missing (required observed).\n"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    missing_by_signal$pct_missing[
      missing_by_signal$signal %in% c(0L, 2L, 3L)
    ] == 0
  )
)

cat(
  "\nPASS: all required signals are fully observed.\n"
)
```
